title: Procurement Lead
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------


Blue Energy is transforming how nuclear power gets built. Instead of constructing each plant on\-site from scratch \- a process that takes 10\-15 years and is too expensive and unpredictable to finance \- we build our plants like ships: in a factory, on an assembly line, then transport and assemble them at the site. This cuts costs by over 60% and brings plants online in just three years. We also pair natural gas with nuclear at our sites, so customers can start receiving power from gas turbines right away and then switch over to clean nuclear power once it comes online \- getting energy to the grid faster while nuclear is being built. Our mission is to make nuclear energy abundant, affordable, and repeatable at global scale. We use proven, already\-approved reactor designs and work with existing nuclear and industrial sites, giving us a faster path to regulatory approval. By manufacturing this way, we put nuclear power on the same cost\-reduction curve that has made wind, solar, and batteries cheaper every year.

title: Controls and Automation Project Development Manager
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**


Join us as a CP LMU Controls Project Development Manager, where you will play a pivotal role in driving our sales and business development efforts in the Controls and Automation Systems sector. Imagine leading strategic initiatives that leverage your expertise in controls and automation products to create innovative solutions for our clients. You will engage with diverse teams, collaborating across organizational and international boundaries to ensure project success. Your self\-motivation and high\-energy drive will be key as you navigate the dynamic landscape of our industry, making a significant impact on our growth and success.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Individual contributor role focused on business development and sales growth within controls, automation systems, and rotating equipment solutions.
* 50–70% domestic travel required to meet customers, stakeholders, and build strong client relationships.
* Identify and develop upgrade opportunities for existing steam turbines and generators, driving new sales and market expansion.
* Partner with Client Managers to assess customer equipment challenges, needs, and business goals, then recommend tailored solutions.
* Serve as the primary customer\-facing resource, providing expert guidance on control and automation systems while maintaining CRM/Salesforce updates.
* Manage the sales pipeline and market awareness, creating a strong sales funnel and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to execute strategic growth initiatives

**What You Bring**

* A bachelor’s degree in a related field is required; a degree in Electrical, Controls, Automation Engineering or a related Engineering field is preferred.
* Minimum of 8 years’ combined experience with sales/business development and Controls and Automation Systems is required; Candidates with more experience may be eligible for a more senior level role.
* Strategic orientation with detailed knowledge of controls and automation product

title: Director Engineering and Construction
description:
**Company Overview**

Kirkwood Infrastructure Group (KIG) is a carrier neutral long\-haul fiber network and infrastructure provider, as well as the owner / operator of colocation facilities along its routes, a metro fiber optic network in downtown Miami and optical transport (managed services) provider. The KIG Florida long\-haul network consists of high\-count fiber backbones, five integrated colocation facilities along the 360\-mile East coast of Florida from Miami to Jacksonville, and multiple laterals interconnecting third party data centers, subsea cable stations, and key peering points.

**Position Overview \& Responsibilities**

The Director of Engineering and Construction has responsibility to engineer, design, and project manage network expansions and system improvements for the KIG Florida network. To manage the day\-to\-day operations, maintenance and repair of the company’s network infrastructure. To manage the economic and financial viability of all network additions and customer contracts.

The Director of Engineering and Construction shall work closely with the CNO to provide direction and planning for the development of the company’s fiber optic network and colocation facilities. Plan future expansions and upgrades to the network with present and future business opportunities in mind. Manage the company’s fiber and colocation assets to ensure that adequate capacity is available to meet ongoing business needs and restoration requirements. Direct the engineering, design and project management of the company’s network construction. Continuously review construction methods for improved alternatives through new technology and equipment. Introduce new fiber optic products and construction methods. Provide planning and management of the engineering and design of high speed, reliable data network systems for internal communications. Review internal and external construction activities and customer needs for future communications related business opportunitie
